name: Party Identification And Account 229
definition: Party involved in the settlement chain.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the account owned by the party.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Specifies the reference of the transaction at the party identified in the sequence.

ProcessingDate.name: Processing Date
ProcessingDate.definition: Date and optionally the time, at which this transaction was processed by the party identified in this sequence.

SubAccount.name: Sub Account
SubAccount.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.
